name: Craftwork
summary: Marketplace of 3,300+ design packs and 40,000+ assets: illustrations, mockups, icon sets, fonts, templates and React components.
description: Craftwork is a marketplace of hand-picked design assets organised in packs: illustrations, 3D, mockups, backgrounds, fonts, 77,000+ SVG icons, Figma/Framer/Webflow templates and animated React/Tailwind components. A free account gets five premium assets a month; Pro ($149/year or $449 lifetime) unlocks every pack, a Figma plugin and an MCP server for AI agents.
contains: 77,762 SVG icons with size, stroke and color controls; copy as SVG, React or Vue
992 animated React and Tailwind components from several open-source libraries
templates for Figma, Framer, Webflow, Jitter, Notion and presentations
plans: free with 5 premium assets a month; Pro $49/quarter, $149/year, $449 lifetime, $299/year team
MCP server for Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor and Lovable; Figma plugin
